before.requirement: Strictly unpack an object and reject a member unconsumed by the object format.
before.reason: The object format has no ! marker, and json_unpack supplies zero flags. The other unpack calls provide no equivalent strict object check.

after.requirement: Strictly unpack an object and reject a member unconsumed by the object format.
after.reason: Strict object validation remains available, but the same object format and zero flags cannot select it.

claims.reason: Both versions support the same strict object rejection. On both sides, the fixed harness uses {s?o} without !, while [o!] applies strictness only to an array.
